text: Irakli Kobakhidze - Just like the Prime Minister, the State Minister will be fully served by the resources of the Government Administration; there is nothing to mock here, though the opposition manages to speculate even here – this is their true face and it is not interesting (28.04.2026, 16:17)

"Just as the Prime Minister, the Vice Prime Minister and the State Minister for the Coordination of Law Enforcement Agencies will be served entirely by the resources of the Government Administration – you yourselves understand that there is nothing to ridicule here, though the opposition manages to spread speculations even here – this is their face and it is not interesting," Prime Minister Irakli Kobakhidze told journalists.
According to him, the purpose of creating the new structural unit is to further strengthen the law enforcement system.

“These changes served to further strengthen the law enforcement system. A new link has emerged – a coordination link. Mamuka Mdinaradze was performing this function even before, but from a specific agency. This was the factual situation. We decided to formalize the reality, which is correct and which had already been established before. In reality, there will be independent structures. Naturally, these are the Ministry of Internal Affairs, the State Security Service, the Special State Protection Service, and [the position] will ensure their general coordination. The new position of State Minister is intended for this, which will further strengthen the fight against crime and the care for protecting public order. You know that during this one year, we have had fundamental changes in all directions,” Kobakhidze stated.

Furthermore, the Prime Minister responded to a question regarding parallels between the imprisoned former head of the SSG, Grigol Liluashvili, and Mamuka Mdinaradze, noting that "then the processes unfolded differently, now they will proceed differently."

"The reality is radically different. The context is completely different. Mamuka Mdinaradze is an exceptionally successful member of our team. Specifically, his work in the State Security Service was exceptionally successful, including in the areas of corruption and terrorist crime. He implemented very important systemic changes. This is a different background; accordingly, against a different background, future development will also be different," Kobakhidze stated.

Parliament is considering a draft law through an expedited procedure, on the basis of which the position of State Minister for the Coordination of Law Enforcement Agencies is being introduced within the Government of Georgia. According to the draft, the Government Administration will provide material-technical and organizational support for the activities of the new State Minister.

According to the Parliamentary Secretary of the Government, Vakhtang Bachiashvili, the powers of the State Minister will be specified in a government decree. According to him, the State Minister for Law Enforcement Coordination Issues will be located in the Government Administration building.
